confidenceLevels.high: Source scope, license, target mapping, and transform path are confirmed enough for source-backed planning display after import approval.
confidenceLevels.medium: Source scope and license are recorded, but one or more mapping or transform assumptions still need operator review before production-style use.
confidenceLevels.low: Source is useful for exploratory planning only; field semantics, joins, or enrichment are not strong enough for production-style use.
confidenceLevels.blocked: No source-backed planning use is allowed until a source, license, scope, and transform path are recorded.

requiredBeforeApiPromotion: Confirm the business meaning of cbps.total_indus.
Provide a Census API key or cached NAICS title reference for cbps.cnaic_name.
Decide whether aggregate NAICS placeholders require a schema migration.
tableAssessments.notes: Municipality-level CBP data is Puerto Rico-scoped, but important legacy field semantics are still unresolved.

requiredBeforeApiPromotion: Add deterministic DBF extraction for the official municipality boundary ZIP.
Confirm county code normalization across boundary and CBP municipality sources.
tableAssessments.notes: The source is official and Puerto Rico-scoped, but the current planner does not yet consume the ZIP/DBF source directly.

requiredBeforeApiPromotion: Keep unmatched or ambiguous NCES coordinate joins in manual review.
Document that the Datos.PR directory is a replacement-source candidate, not confirmed original hackathon input.
Keep legacy unis.desc limited to non-personal institutional display fields until a richer future schema is designed.
tableAssessments.notes: Institution rows can be source-backed, but coordinate enrichment depends on a cautious deterministic join and contact/person fields are excluded from the display summary.

blockedTables.reason: No confirmed Puerto Rico-only source defines career-department semantics or preserved joins beyond adjacent NAICS values.
No confirmed Puerto Rico-only public source supplies business title, physical address, point coordinates, and a defensible cdepts/NAICS join.
No confirmed Puerto Rico-only source provides university-to-NAICS or career-department rate by year.

promotionRule: Rows may be displayed as source-backed planning data only when their sourceId is registered, their table has a table assessment, sourceBacked is true, and productionReadiness is not blocked. Rows must not be described as production-grade until requiredBeforeApiPromotion is empty or explicitly waived in release evidence.
